_comment: Example Claude Code hooks that put a domain expert in the loop while an agent codes.
WHY PostToolUse with --warn-only: a hook fires after EVERY file write, and blocking every write
would make the agent unusable. It reports the expert's issues as the work happens.
WHY Stop without --warn-only: that is the checkpoint with teeth — the turn cannot end on a change
the expert rejected, so the agent has to address the issues before reporting done.
Set MCP_URL, MCP_TOKEN and MCP_DOMAIN in the environment the agent runs in.

hooks.command: python tools/mcp-review-gate/review_gate.py --warn-only --context "file just edited by the agent"
